compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center / Kensington Senior Development

notes: DCA original prospective need was 427 units; after Vacant Land Adjustment (VLA), Ridgewood's Realistic Development Potential (RDP) was reduced to 4 units, all satisfied via existing housing credits (16 credits banked, only 4 required). Present need (rehabilitation) figure not confirmed in search results — set to null pending HEFSP review. HEFSP adopted by Planning Board July 1, 2025. In September 2025, Fair Share Housing Center and Kensington Senior Development sued after the Council rejected a zoning overlay for a proposed 125-bed assisted living facility at North Maple Ave (Block 3611, Lots 1, 19, 22), which was listed in the HEFSP. As of early 2026 the village was in court-mediated settlement talks with a Dec 31, 2025 compliance deadline. Ordinance #4052 defeated Aug 13, 2025; Ordinance #4071 (S-1 Senior Overlay) under consideration with a Feb 11, 2026 vote. Status coded in_progress because litigation/settlement outcome is unresolved.

notes: Rockleigh is designated a National Historic District in northeast Bergen County; approximately 650 acres, almost entirely built out with single-family residences. Resolution #2025-19 (adopted January 28, 2025) agreed to 0 present need and 14 prospective need. HEFSP public hearing held June 23, 2025. Vacant Land Analysis disclosed only 1 available vacant parcel (Borough-owned, retained for future public purpose) — this limits RDP. Borough relies on Accessory Apartment Program (up to 5 creditable units, subsidized at $35,000/unit for very-low-income or $20,000/unit for moderate-income) to meet prospective need. Existing Spectrum for Living group home (16-bed supervised apartment, CO October 1998) provides 4 prior-round credits with 12 surplus. Settlement party name not found in search results. research_status coded done because all core data found.
